results.action: org.wikipedia.dev is already launched by the runner or by setup; do not use launcher search or intents. If onboarding appears, tap Forward until Skip is available, then tap Skip. From the main feed, tap the bottom Search tab (nav_tab_search), then tap search_card to open SearchActivity.
